image_description: A close-up view of a vintage comic book cover featuring stylized, somewhat grotesque character illustrations. The cover has a red header with bold, distorted yellow and black typography. Two main characters are visible: one in a pink outfit holding an object, and another with dark hair and pale skin. The art style is reminiscent of underground comix or horror comics. There are signs of wear and tear on the physical object.
